Frequently Asked Questions

What investor relations solutions does PR Newswire offer?

PR Newswire offers integrated investor relations solutions to help public companies communicate accurately, consistently and confidently with investors and financial media. Solutions include secure financial news distribution, earnings release dissemination, IR and ESG websites, webcasts and teleconferencing events, and targeted outreach to investors and analysts through Market Lists, powered by Irwin.

How does PR Newswire help public companies distribute financial news?

PR Newswire distributes financial news through one of the industry’s most established and trusted global disclosure networks, helping public companies meet disclosure requirements while reaching investors, analysts and financial media at scale. Secure technology, editorial review and proven distribution processes help companies reduce risk, maintain consistency and ensure financial news is delivered accurately and reliably across key investor channels.

What is an Investor Relations (IR) website?

An investor relations website is a dedicated section of a company’s website that provides investors, analysts and media with timely access to key financial information such as earnings releases, material news, financial statements, event replays, stock data and governance content. A well-maintained IR website helps reinforce transparency, support compliance, and build long-term investor confidence.

Does PR Newswire support investor webcasts and earnings calls?

Yes, PR Newswire supports audio and video investor webcasts, earnings calls and virtual investor events, including end-to-end production and event management services. Experienced webcast producers help ensure professional execution, reliable delivery and seamless experience for both presenters and investors.

public companies have trusted PR Newswire to distribute financial news and connect with investors, analysts and media. Our IR solutions unify earnings distribution, investor events and IR websites to help increase visibility, engage the right audiences and build investor confidence. Get Started Deliver Financial News with Greater Reach and Impact Reach analysts, investors, stakeholders and financial media outlets through the industry’s most trusted distribution network. Target 400,000+ investors and analysts from thousands of financial institutions covering 13 industries worldwide with curated Market Lists powered by Irwin. Publish news to 6,400+ financial, news and research websites—including Yahoo! Finance, Benzinga and The Street—via PR Newswire’s comprehensive full disclosure networks. Directly reach the inboxes of thousands of journalists within our opt-in PR Newswire for Journalists community—and secure valuable earned media coverage for your brand. Measure your story’s reach and engagement with a robust reporting dashboard. Depend on Best-in-Class Support and Secure Distribution PR Newswire combines secure technology, IR and editorial expertise and trusted distribution to help public companies communicate with confidence. Access everything from one convenient IR dashboard within the SOC 2 Type II-compliant PR Newswire Amplify™ platform. Count on 24/7 support—including full editorial review of your earnings release—from our PR and content experts, who manage over 40,000 IR releases per year. Over 22,000 errors in client copy were identified before distribution last year alone. With one integrated workflow, updates made to your release automatically carry across website postings, investor alerts and more, helping ensure consistency across channels. Easily Deploy, Update and Maintain an Engaging IR Website Create a secure, branded investor relations website that keeps investors, analysts and stakeholders informed with timely financial news and content. Launch a fully hosted, custom IR website that seamlessly aligns with your company’s digital brand guidelines Automatically and instantly post press releases and content issued to your IR website from your PR Newswire account. Feature content such as interactive stock tools and charts, financial statements, corporate governance content, earnings calls, webcasts, events and presentations. Track visitor engagement, traffic sources and audience insights and offer email alerts for investors. Learn More Produce Professional, Stress-Free Webcasts & Calls Our experienced, award-winning team of webcast producers will help you host webcasts, earnings conference calls and events that showcase your leadership, enhance your credibility, and fit seamlessly into your shareholder communication workflow. Audio webcasts : Connect to a global audience via a branded media player that supports Q&A chat with speakers and much more. Video webcasts : Stream live video from any venue, from a conference room to a concert hall. Teleconferencing : Host a live teleconference using our web-based, operator-assisted control room, or run a pre-recorded presentation followed by live Q&A. Our conferencing solution provides you with the ease and convenience of a single point of accountability to schedule and manage your events. It has not been another full-time job to manage this website. Read Case Study Frequently Asked Questions What investor relations solutions does PR Newswire offer ? PR Newswire offers integrated investor relations solutions to help public companies communicate accurately, consistently and confidently with investors and financial media. Solutions include secure financial news distribution, earnings release dissemination, IR and ESG websites, webcasts and teleconferencing events, and targeted outreach to investors and analysts through Market Lists, powered by Irwin. How does PR Newswire help public companies distribute financial news ? PR Newswire distributes financial news through one of the industry’s most established and trusted global disclosure networks, helping public companies meet disclosure requirements while reaching investors, analysts and financial media at scale. Secure technology, editorial review and proven distribution processes help companies reduce risk, maintain consistency and ensure financial news is delivered accurately and reliably across key investor channels. What is an Investor Relations (IR) website ? An investor relations website is a dedicated section of a company’s website that provides investors, analysts and media with timely access to key financial information such as earnings releases, material news, financial statements, event replays, stock data and governance content. A well-maintained IR website helps reinforce transparency, support compliance, and build long-term investor confidence. Does PR Newswire support investor webcasts and earnings calls ? Yes, PR Newswire supports audio and video investor webcasts, earnings calls and virtual investor events, including end-to-end production and event management services. What is PR Newswire AI?

PR Newswire AI is a powerful suite of generative AI tools integrated into the Amplify platform. Built specifically for communications professionals, it streamlines the entire PR workflow, from campaign planning and content creation to distribution of press releases. By combining third-party technology (Google Gemini Enterprise) with proprietary models trained on years of press release performance data and editorial best practices, our AI helps brands quickly and easily craft high-quality, results-driven content that effectively tells your brand’s story.

How does the AI align with my company’s brand voice?

Our AI studies your past press releases as well as your company website to understand your unique style and tone. For new platform users, the tool will reference similar companies in your industry in addition to your website. While drafting a new release with our tool, make sure to review and edit the text directly so that it fits your needs. The more content you create with our AI solution, the more familiar it will become with your brand voice.

How does the Press Release Score work?

The Press Release Score provides insights and tailored recommendations to improve press release content. By leveraging historical performance data, industry best practices and generative AI, the tool evaluates your release from "Poor" to "Great." It evaluates key elements such as headlines, quotes, structure, calls to action and news angles, offering actionable feedback for refinement. This feature speeds up the drafting process and enhances the quality of content.

Can I still have the editorial team, or a live person review my release before distribution?

Yes, you always have 24/7/365 access to our editorial team. They are expert advisors when it comes to press release writing, SEO and the PR industry, and they are happy to assist you with reviewing and editing releases before submission. It’s important to remember that you retain responsibility for the accuracy of your release, including AI-generated content and quotes. PR Newswire AI is a powerful suite of generative AI tools integrated into the Amplify platform. Built specifically for communications professionals, it streamlines the entire PR workflow, from campaign planning and content creation to distribution of press releases. By combining third-party technology (Google Gemini Enterprise) with proprietary models trained on years of press release performance data and editorial best practices, our AI helps brands quickly and easily craft high-quality, results-driven content that effectively tells your brand’s story. How does the AI align with my company’s brand voice? Our AI studies your past press releases as well as your company website to understand your unique style and tone. It evaluates key elements such as headlines, quotes, structure, calls to action and news angles, offering actionable feedback for refinement. This feature speeds up the drafting process and enhances the quality of content. Can I still have the editorial team, or a live person review my release before distribution? Yes, you always have 24/7/365 access to our editorial team. They are expert advisors when it comes to press release writing, SEO and the PR industry, and they are happy to assist you with reviewing and editing releases before submission. It’s important to remember that you retain responsibility for the accuracy of your release, including AI-generated content and quotes. About PR Newswire

Founded in 1954 by Herbert Muschel and acquired by Cision in 2015, PR Newswire is the industry’s leading press release distribution partner with an unparalleled global reach of more than 440,000 newsrooms, websites, direct feeds, journalists and influencers and is available in more than 170 countries and 40 languages. From our award-winning Content Services offerings, integrated media newsroom and microsite products, Investor Relations suite of services, paid placement and social sharing tools, PR Newswire has a comprehensive catalog of solutions to solve the modern-day challenges PR and communications teams face. For 70 years, PR Newswire has been the preferred destination for brands to share their most important news stories across the world.

Global Leadership Team

 

Guy Abramo
Chief Executive Officer, Cision

I’m Guy Abramo and I’m the Chief Executive Officer.

I am an accomplished leader and board director with experience spanning multiple industries including technology, financial services, and consulting. Most recently I served as CEO of HireRight, where I led its IPO in 2021 and its take-private transaction in 2024. Prior to HireRight, I held senior roles at organizations such as Experian, Tallan, Ingram Micro, KPMG Consulting, and Exxon/Mobil, consistently delivering transformative growth, innovative solutions, and operational excellence.

I hold a Bachelor’s degree in Chemical Engineering from New Jersey Institute of Technology (NJIT) and an MBA from Georgetown University. I’m known for my collaborative leadership style and commitment to empowering teams to succeed.

 

Matthew Brown
President, PR Newswire

Matt Brown is President of PR Newswire. He has spent his career leading businesses and teams in the information services, FinTech, and news industries, ranging from startups to Fortune 500 companies.

Matt joined PR Newswire from Signal AI, where he served as President, Americas & Asia-Pacific. Prior to that, he held commercial leadership and GM roles at Thomson Reuters and Nasdaq, where he was Global Head of Sales of the Corporate Solutions business unit. He also enjoys an active interest in the early-stage tech ecosystem where he has had the pleasure to invest in and advise numerous exceptional, high-velocity businesses.

Matt graduated with a BA in Philosophy from Trinity College in Connecticut, is an active traveler and hiker, and lives in New York with his son.

Highlights of my career include leading the global sales and service support functions of a $6bn revenue enterprise, founding and scaling a digital media startup to multi-million dollar annual revenues and millions of daily users, and building a new solutions business at Thomson Reuters that grew threefold to reach $1bn in revenue.

At my core, I’m a teacher and coach — recognized as a Top 50 Leading Light in the UK for kindness in business leadership (2018) and a Top 100 Global Sales Leader (2022).

With over 20 years of experience in tech-enabled services and FinTech, I’m passionate about delivering customer-centric solutions, expanding market opportunities, and enhancing operational efficiency.

I’ve spearheaded product strategy and business transformation at companies like HireRight, Digital Trusted Identity Services (DTIS), and Affinion Group, where I helped scale product portfolios, launch new revenue streams, and optimize go-to-market strategies. I thrive in high-performance cultures, fostering collaboration across teams to bring ideas to life.

I have a strategic, results-oriented approach, helping organizations modernize their technology infrastructure and gain a competitive edge.

When I’m not shaping Cision’s technology strategy, I’m passionate about mentoring teams, exploring advancements in AI, and driving innovation that makes a measurable impact.

Earlier in my career, I held leadership roles at Deloitte, advising Fortune 500 companies on workforce transformation and organizational effectiveness.

Originally from the East Coast, I studied at the Binghamton University. Outside of work, I enjoy spending time with my family, fishing, and coaching my sons’ wrestling and football teams.

 

Matthew Robarge
Chief Financial Officer

I'm Matt Robarge, Chief Financial Officer at Cision. I lead our global finance organization with a focus on operational excellence, business alignment, and enabling scalable growth. With a background in both public accounting and corporate finance, I bring a practical, results-driven approach to building high-performing, efficient financial operations.

Throughout my career, I’ve overseen a wide range of functions, including general ledger, order-to-cash, financial reporting, tax, treasury, sourcing, and payroll—supporting teams across 11 countries. My work has been centered on transformation initiatives, from ERP and system migrations to process automation and acquisition integration, consistently driving cost savings and long-term efficiency gains.

Based in North Carolina, I enjoy DIY projects, traveling with my family, and cheering on my Virginia Tech Hokies football team—where my wife and I met during our college years.

 

Dylan Marvin
Chief Customer Officer, Cision

I'm Dylan Marvin, Chief Customer Officer at Cision, where I lead our teams in helping customers maximize the value of our platform and services. We guide the entire post-sales journey, from onboarding and customer success to support and professional services and operations.

Throughout my career, I've held global leadership roles across B2B and B2C technology and media companies, spanning both legal and operational functions. Prior to Cision, I was the Chief Administrative and Legal Office for Brandwatch, covering Legal, Privacy, Facilities, IT, Rev Ops, and the People Team.

I hold a BA from Occidental College and Law degrees from Thomas Jefferson School of Law and University College London. I live in New York with my wife and our dog. In my spare time I love playing basketball, reading, roasting coffee, and a nice cocktail.
